en.description:
How fast can you tap? Test your focus and speed in this minimalist number puzzle! Tap the numbers in order as quickly as possible.

【New: Difficulty Levels】 Choose the challenge that fits your skill
- Easy: 2 x 2 grid – Perfect for a quick warm-up.
- Normal: 3 x 3 grid – A balanced test of speed.
- Hard: 4 x 4 grid – Only for the sharpest minds!
【Game Features】
- Simple yet deep: Simply tap numbers in order, starting from 1, to clear them. You'll be hooked.
- Clear all numbers within the time limit to move on to the next stage: The time limit gets stricter as you progress through the stages.
- Multi-layer system: Numbers overlap in the second and third stages, increasing the difficulty!
- No mistakes allowed: If you tap incorrectly, the previous number will reappear as a penalty.
【Rules & Features】
- Time Limit: Each level and stage has a time limit based on its difficulty.
- Auto-Save: Your high score for each level is automatically saved.
- Exit: Long press the screen any time to return to the start screen.

Simple, addictive, and perfect for training your brain on the go.
en.releaseNotes:
New Difficulty Levels Added! You can now choose your preferred challenge. We’ve added Normal and Hard modes to the original Easy mode:
- Easy: 2 x 2 grid
- Normal: 3 x 3 grid
- Hard: 4 x 4 grid
Test your speed and see how far you can go!
en.subtitle: Fast Number Tapping Challenge
